about_the_game:
Experience Classical Music Like Never Before

Bach, Liszt, Beethoven, Chopin...

Play iconic classical pieces in an unconventional way. Rotate and drop falling blocks to accumulate energy of different colors and compose stunning musical passages. Trust your instincts, aim for high scores, and keep pushing your limits. Oh, and it might even help your neck posture!

  • Color

    Once a color spectrum is fully charged, all blocks of that color will be cleared.

  • Piano

    Piano keys bounce and shine with every note. Blocks cleared by a Max color spectrum effect will charge up energy on the piano keyboard.

  • Combo Line

    Clearing rows consecutively builds up combo energy. You’re waiting for that perfect burst—it just might save you in a moment of crisis.

    ……

  • And More mechanics waiting to be explored!
